summary: Completed E2E testing of ENZI AI Auto-Responses, Conversation Summaries, Scheduled Messages, Bot/Automation Platform, and Notification Settings features (iteration 191). All 31 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI components verified working - Schedule, Summarize, and Notification Settings buttons in channel header, with functional modals.
critical_code_review_comments: enzi_ai.py: AI auto-reply suggestions correctly map bucket categories to quick replies
enzi_ai.py: AI summarize endpoint properly fetches messages and generates summaries via LLM
enzi_automation.py: Scheduled messages validate future time requirement correctly
enzi_automation.py: Webhooks support multiple event types (message, member_join, member_leave)
enzi_notifications.py: Per-channel notification levels (all/mentions/none) with proper validation
ScheduleMessageModal.jsx: Uses browser native date/time inputs with proper default values
NotificationSettings.jsx: Clean UI with DND toggle, keyword alerts, per-channel controls
ConversationSummary.jsx: Displays AI-generated summary with message count
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin credentials. Test data created during pytest includes scheduled messages, webhooks, auto-responders, keywords
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features for iteration 191 are working: 1) AI Auto-Reply Suggestions (POST /api/lumi/ai/auto-reply/suggestions) returns bucket-specific quick replies with optional AI-generated suggestion. 2) AI Summarize (POST /api/lumi/ai/summarize) generates conversation summaries from channel messages. 3) Scheduled Messages (POST/GET/DELETE /api/lumi/automation/schedule) with future-time validation and background processor. 4) Webhooks (POST/GET/DELETE /api/lumi/automation/webhooks and /{id}/send) for bot integrations - no auth needed for sending. 5) Auto-Responders (POST/GET/DELETE /api/lumi/automation/auto-responders) for keyword triggers. 6) Notification Preferences (/api/lumi/notifications/*) with DND schedule, keyword alerts, per-channel mute levels. Frontend: Schedule button opens ScheduleMessageModal with date/time picker and pending list. Notification Settings button opens NotificationSettings modal with DND toggle, keyword input, per-channel notification level controls. Summarize button visible in header toolbar.

Frontend: Sidebar has Recent and New Message buttons at top
